translations.instruction:
In the "{{sheet}}" sheet, each row has a text in one of the language columns ({{languages}}) and the other language columns empty.
Fill in only these empty cells, translating the text of the same row into the language of the column.
Do not change any other cell; do not add, delete, move or sort rows; do not rename sheets.
These are business process names: keep labels short. Steps: verb and object ("Valider la commande" becomes "Approve the order"). Item, Code and Context columns: for understanding only.
150 characters at most, 200 for the project and the maps, 60 for the arrows.
translations.instruction_glossary: Follow the glossary of the project, given after this instruction.
